text: 【午盘播报】沪指上涨0.08%，报3959.64点；深成指下跌0.14%，报14029.83点；创业板指下跌0.32%，报3462.07点，两市半日合计成交14233亿。盘面上，种植业、房地产服务、渔业、供销社概念、饰品、华为欧拉领涨，CRO、生物制品、CAR-T细胞疗法、重组蛋白、创新药、蓝宝石表现不佳，领跌市场。全市场上涨个股有3197家，下跌个股有2196家，63只股涨停。
text_en: 【Midday Market Wrap】The Shanghai Composite Index rose 0.08% to 3,959.64 points; the Shenzhen Component Index fell 0.14% to 14,029.83 points; the ChiNext Index fell 0.32% to 3,462.07 points. Combined half-day turnover on the two markets reached 1,423.3 billion yuan. On the board, crop farming, real estate services, fisheries, supply and marketing cooperatives, accessories, and Huawei Euler led gains, while CRO, biological products, CAR-T cell therapy, recombinant proteins, innovative drugs, and sapphire underperformed, leading declines. Across the market, 3,197 stocks rose, 2,196 fell, and 63 hit the daily limit up.
